openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing red and argue (incorrectly) that red is the only way to guarantee survival in equilibrium, while also acknowledging blue could be rational if blue is expected to be the majority; they do not identify red as the dominant strategy and they misapply the mechanics by treating blue-majority as not guaranteeing survival for red-pressers.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent correctly identifies the game theory structure, acknowledges the dominance of the red button (that red-pressers survive regardless of the outcome), and chooses red. They also provide a sophisticated steelman of the blue strategy, correctly identifying that blue is only rational if one has a high belief (p > 0.5) that others will also choose blue. They demonstrate a clear understanding of dominant strategy reasoning and apply it correctly to the red button.
